  3420

  3422	
  3423	`model-committee` enforces the loop accepted in `UBU-D0066` with three priority levels:
  3424	
  3425	1. system-wide consistency;
  3426	2. question/problem prioritization;
  3427	3. ordinary work.
  3428

  3430	
  3431	System-wide consistency checks run before prioritization and ordinary work. They are triggered by:
  3432	
  3433	- new base commit, merge, rebase, checkout, or human-applied patch affecting canonical files;
  3434	- directive decision or other direct edit to `DECISIONS.md`;
  3435	- edits to `DESIGN.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`, or `PLANNING_KERNEL_CONTRACT.md`;

  3437	- enabled LLM model, model-alias, or provider capability changes;
  3438	- Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, Ollama, or other approved provider CLI version or behavior changes;
  3439	- explicit operator request, scheduled audit, doctor run, or prior run ending with consistency, quorum, or validation failure;
  3440	- derived-document changes when derived-document checks are enabled.
  3441

  3443	
  3444	- missing or unparseable canonical files;
  3445	- duplicate question or decision IDs;
  3446	- malformed question metadata;
  3447	- dependency references to missing questions;
  3448	- dependency cycles;
  3449	- invalid `Resolved by` references;
  3450	- solved, decomposed, deferred, or superseded status contradictions;
  3451	- selected-work dependency violations;
  3452	- patch-base mismatch or canonical input changes after the consistency snapshot;
  3453	- forbidden-path proposals.
